data.text: I’ll commit to 10 tons this month. My family made its living on this lake, and I want all five of us to be able to count on it next month too. Luke, I appreciate you laying out the costs honestly, but I’d rather earn steadily than take a bigger catch now and sit idle later. With the four of us committed, will you join us at 10? Then we can review the catches together next month and keep the agreement fair.
